info.name: Amplitude Attribution Annotations Funnel Analysis API

params.name: e
params.description: A JSON-encoded event object with at minimum an event_type field. For funnel analysis, multiple e parameters define each funnel step.

params.name: start
params.description: The start date in YYYYMMDD format.

params.name: end
params.description: The end date in YYYYMMDD format.

params.name: n
params.description: The conversion window in days. Default varies by project settings.

params.name: s
params.description: Segment definitions as a JSON-encoded array.

params.name: g
params.description: The property to group results by.

items.docs: Get funnel drop-off and conversion rates for a sequence of events. Each event parameter in the query string defines a step in the funnel.
